recentItems.title: Steve Irwin's cameraman recounts his final moments | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
Today marks 20 years since the world lost the Crocodile Hunter, Steve Irwin.

Justin Lyons filmed Steve Irwin's most iconic encounters for fifteen years, and he always knew that he might one day capture the wildlife icon's death as well.

Irwin was pierced in the chest by a stingray on the Great Barrier Reef, bleeding out in a small boat as he looked his mate in the eye.

Watch Steve Irwin: A Wild Life on the 60 Minutes Australia YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/sRhJtsUH5VI

recentItems.title: Inside China's eerie empty megacities | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
As China's economy boomed, giant metropolises seemingly shot out of no where. Cities were being built faster than architects could plan them. But in cities like Yujiapu the boom outran the demand as it still stands as ghost town.

recentItems.title: The moment a shark attack survivor woke up from a coma | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
Leah Stewart was in a medically-induced coma for 10 days after she was attacked by a great white shark in the waters of Sydney’s Coogee Beach. During the time she was having nightmares and reliving the horrific memories over and over in her head, her loved ones stayed close by waiting for the moment she woke up from deep sedation.

recentItems.description:

The deadly reptile repeatedly lunged at the surfer's legs after mistaking his bright white socks for a raw chicken.
